plain: To ask for or try to obtain, such as votes or money

webster.text: To ask with some degree of earnestness; to make petition to; to apply to for obtaining something.

more.text: To awake or excite to action; to summon; to invite.
To attempt; to try to obtain.

example.quote: They solicit the attention of those only, who add to a sincere zeal for the happiness of their country, a temper favorable to a just estimate of the means of promoting it.
